timing.notes: Feature extraction cost is NOT included in these timings.

resource_profiling.scope: model predict/testing only; model training, feature extraction, data loading, tuning, serialization, graphing and report generation are excluded
resource_profiling.process_scope: current process plus recursive child processes
resource_profiling.cpu_definition: aggregate process-tree user+system CPU seconds; average utilization = 100 * CPU seconds / wall seconds; may exceed 100 for parallel workloads
resource_profiling.memory_definition: aggregate process-tree RSS bytes sampled during workload; shared pages can be counted by more than one process

resource.scope: Tier 1, model-only: scikit-learn predict() on pre-extracted features. PCAP parsing, feature extraction, data loading, training and tuning are excluded. Host measurement, not a Raspberry Pi measurement.

method.isolation: fresh subprocess per measurement; no training data; no sampler thread; GC enabled
method.cpu: process_time delta / packets over >= min_seconds of continuous predict(); n_jobs=1; pinned CPU
method.memory: RSS/USS ladder (baseline, sklearn import, model load, input, warm-up, after loop) + OS peak RSS
method.core_load: core_load_pct = rate_pps * cpu_us_per_pkt * 1e-4 (100% = one fully busy core)
